stepBody:
To choose the most optimal $$\lambda, $$ Namjoon uses 5-fold cross-validation to train $$5$$ models and stores the appropriate root-mean square error for each fold and $$\lambda.$$ Given the collected statistics about the cross-validation error for each model, help Namjoon choose the value of $$\lambda$$ (among the $$5$$ listed) that is the best to use with exponential regularization.

A. $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$0.001$$
B. $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$0.01$$
C. $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$0.1$$
D. $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$1$$
E. $$\lambda$$ $$=$$ $$10$$
